SELECT r.* FROM gkzh_zdyp_record r
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.attempt_no >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS started, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.first_attempt_correct = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS firstCorrect, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.first_attempt_correct = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS firstPass, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.attempt_no > 1 THEN r.attempt_no - 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reattemptTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.timeout_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS timeoutPlayers, COALESCE(SUM(r.timeout_count), 0) AS timeoutTotal, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.first_attempt_ms END), 0), 0) AS avgFirstMs, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.best_ms END), 0), 0) AS avgBestMs, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.best_ms END), 0) AS minBestMs, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.best_ms END), 0) AS maxBestMs FROM gkzh_zdyp_record r

SELECT r.behavior_type AS behaviorType, MAX(r.behavior_name) AS behaviorName, COUNT(*) AS playerCount FROM gkzh_zdyp_record r
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.behavior_type IS NOT NULL AND r.behavior_type <> '' GROUP BY r.behavior_type ORDER BY playerCount DESC, behaviorType

SELECT a.slot_code AS slotCode, COUNT(*) AS placedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wrongCount FROM gkzh_zdyp_answer a INNER JOIN gkzh_zdyp_attempt t ON t.attempt_id = a.attempt_id AND t.attempt_no = 1 INNER JOIN gkzh_zdyp_record r ON r.record_id = t.record_id
GROUP BY a.slot_code

SELECT t.first_slot_code AS slotCode, COUNT(*) AS playerCount FROM gkzh_zdyp_attempt t INNER JOIN gkzh_zdyp_record r ON r.record_id = t.record_id
AND t.attempt_no = 1 AND t.first_slot_code IS NOT NULL AND t.first_slot_code <> '' GROUP BY t.first_slot_code ORDER BY playerCount DESC, slotCode

SELECT r.career_code AS careerCode, MAX(r.career_name) AS careerName, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishedCount FROM gkzh_zdyp_record r
AND r.career_code IS NOT NULL AND r.career_code <> '' GROUP BY r.career_code ORDER BY selectedCount DESC, careerCode

SELECT COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, COUNT(*) AS participantCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishedCount FROM gkzh_zdyp_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') ORDER BY participantCount DESC, departmentName
SELECT * FROM gkzh_zdyp_record WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND game_type = 'zdyp' ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
